headline: Stage 3b: the trainer learns what you ask, not what you mean
lede: retrogames-rl #2515 shipped: a library of nine goals and an evolution-strategies trainer that fine-tunes the BC partner against the live Gauntlet sim. Proven on two goals — progress climbed validation to perfection and hunter doubled the kills while quietly letting the team collapse, confirming the stage plan's stall prediction as trained behavior.

notes.text: progress-rl-v1: validation objective 0.9875 -> 1.0000; held-out 0.9833 exactly matches v4 — the gain was one fractional level and did not generalize. Dense goals are at ceiling on default difficulty.

hunter-rl-v1: objective 0.6125 -> 1.7000, held-out kills 49 -> 108 — but wins fell 6/6 -> 3/6 with 18 hero deaths. Full reward-hacking, live on the board; the 3c matrix now has its first confirmed surprise.

Trainer is deterministic end to end (seeded ES + deterministic sim): a duplicate slot-a session spawned by a warden idle false-positive produced byte-identical artifacts, and the held-out once-registry caught the overlap. Flagged on #1258 with liveness-tuning suggestions.
3c (#2516) waits on the predictions file — those rows come from Claude and Jon, not the lane.
